card.name: Prescribers and physicians as sentence subject
card.fires_on: The word for prescribers or physicians ("Physicians", "Prescri|bers", "pres|cri|bers") when it starts a sentence or clause, usually before "and patients" in a warning. Weaker hits appear on other words that precede a person doing something.

modes.label: Prescriber/physician as subject
modes.description: A prescriber or physician term opens a sentence that addresses clinicians in a label warning.
modes.example: use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible.<< Physicians>> and patients should remain alert for the development

modes.label: Partway through prescribers
modes.description: The middle or end piece of the word prescribers, before a request to ask or be aware.
modes.example: it is important for pres<<cri>>bers to ask patients or their caregivers specifically

modes.label: Scattered non-medical hits
modes.description: A linking word or comma before a person's reaction or action in general text.
modes.example: It is always very painful for parents<< to>> watch their children struggling
